next.reason: 1985: 'If literal-1 is numeric, then it must be an unsigned integer.'; 2023: 'DISPLAY syntax rules 14.9.11.3 restrict only identifier-1, mnemonic-name-1, identifier-2/3; no rule on numeric literal-1'. The 2023 DISPLAY syntax rules cover the statement but no longer require a numeric literal-1 to be an unsigned integer. The GOBACK/STOP literal rules belong to other statements.
